name: savage_gorger_opponent_lost_life_counter_at_end_step
notes: Printed: 'Flying. At the beginning of your end step, if an opponent lost life this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.' The Gorger attacks; P1's ground wall cannot block a flyer, so P1 loses 1. At P0's end step the Gorger gets a +1/+1 counter (2/2).
